selected_scope: A separate two-call known-failure development diagnostic: one model-authored future correction plan followed by one model-authored complete allocation. No new four-stage workflow or main case.

historical_state_preserved.v45: Four task stages completed with the same invalid0.965 vector; original failure remains.
historical_state_preserved.v46: One feedback-grounded correction completed but all11 raw weights stayed unchanged, sum0.965 and residual-0.035. Mathematical and narrow claim audits failed.
historical_state_preserved.new_attempt_selection: Adaptive development after observing those failures; not independent confirmation and not a reset of the attempt denominator.

unchanged_acceptance.requirements: An actual invalid predecessor and its true feedback are visible; the model emits an actually changed raw allocation that satisfies existing constraints; the correction explanation is truthful; no host repair/gold/retry; three independent same-artifact audits pass.
unchanged_acceptance.tolerance_role: Inherited engineering serialization precision, not a new paper-derived effect criterion.

planner.schema: Reuse the existing seven top-level fields and existing stage1 schema. That schema permits0 or11 weights, but this planning-role contract requires exactly weights=[]. Record both facts; do not claim the complete schema itself enforces only0.
planner.output_meaning: An observable prospective correction plan, not hidden thinking and not a submitted allocation.
planner.weight_semantics: An intentional empty array is not a zero-investment portfolio, does not have an accepted allocation sum, and does not itself demonstrate arithmetic failure or success.
planner.guard: After the existing strict shape validation, enforce weights==[]. A violation is preserved as a planning-role contract failure and prevents executor generation; no host removal or truncation of the planner weights.
planner.interpretations: Any existing eleven interpretation rows are source analysis, not a new source-label answer key or a financial submission.
planner.prose_audit: Future intention is not completed action. Empty weights alone does not prove the prose is a valid plan; false claims about earlier or already-completed changes remain auditable. No new keyword/length/quality score is introduced.

executor.inputs: The registered original public inputs, actual frozen failed response and calculator feedback, the factual prior transition record, and the complete unedited new planner response in the recorded history.
executor.schema: Existing final seven-field response with11 raw weights. Public code/type/shape constraints do not prescribe ratings, reasons or weight values.
executor.output_meaning: The sole new final allocation candidate. The model must write the values itself; the host never executes a numerical plan on its behalf.
executor.calculation: Calculate this unchanged raw candidate using only the same public market and stage-visible submitted inputs. No normalization, clipping, projection, cash imputation or corrected-vector substitution.
executor.plan_execution: Preserve differences between intended changes and final raw values. A prose plan or claim that it was executed is not evidence of actual numerical execution.

allowed_transition_feedback.observations: Actual v45 and v46 raw sums/residuals/validity, matched sector-by-sector differences derived from the original unique numeric rows, and genuine calculator reports.
allowed_transition_feedback.specific_observed_fact: The existing v45-to-v46 weight delta is exactly0 for all11 sectors; both raw sums are0.965.
allowed_transition_feedback.provenance: Recompute and hash the transition before inference. Reject missing/duplicate/ambiguous source rows instead of inventing a value.
allowed_transition_feedback.interpretation_limit: The transition identifies no hidden intent, inability mechanism or optimal correction. It is a deterministic observation of prior public-output values.
forbidden_additions: A sector chosen by the host to receive the missing budget mass
A corrected target vector or normalization coefficient/recipe
A model plan written or repaired by the host
Prior offline semantic verdicts, source-label answer tables, hidden source pages or main-case outputs
A requirement that a particular weight must equal the benchmark or a fabricated institution risk cap

bounded_execution.meaning: One planning call and at most one execution call, not two independent repair attempts, not multiple candidate selection and not the original four-stage treatment.
bounded_execution.budget_basis: A predeclared local development bound implementing the selected role separation, not an optimal numeric setting reported in the cited paper.
bounded_execution.inherited_controls: Exact model/digest/template/engine, sampling/penalty/context/output controls, renderer, no-truncation rules and900-second per-call deadline remain pinned. Verify the actual implementation and manifest before inference.
bounded_execution.stop_rules: A transport/pin/render/strict-shape failure stops. A planner nonempty-weight violation stops before executor. A completed invalid executor candidate is recorded as a failed correction, with no extension.

checks: Exact prospective registration/role/input/schema/model pins and finite budget.
Original failures and derived transition match frozen sources; no hidden correction target or evaluator information enters online text.
Planner response is preserved in full and actually visible to executor; host does not apply its plan.
Correct role-specific call counts, termination, failure retention and no retry/repair.
Planning weights=[] is recorded as not submitted, never as a valid portfolio or a new full-workflow success.

three_required_audits.scope: Independent raw arithmetic and existing format contract
checks: Strictly parse original numeric literals and check the planner empty-weight role contract separately from final allocation feasibility.
Independently verify v45-to-v46 factual delta0; do not interpret the empty planner array as a zero vector for subtraction.
For executor only, verify all11 canonical sectors once, finite weights, original long-only bounds and inherited full-investment sum criterion.
Compute exact v46-to-executor deltas and sums without importing a repaired vector or using the runner's validity flag as the answer.
Require an actual final numerical change and valid raw allocation; retain exact residuals and distinguish binary-float calculator precision.
Check statements about the v45/v46 error and unchanged transition against preserved evidence.
Separate prospective plan language from completed-action claims; no literal ACK or verbosity condition.
Compare consequential planner intentions and executor claims of following them against final raw values, with uncertainty or unexecuted actions explicit.
Reject false claims that weights changed, the original invalid candidate was valid, or the final sum is1 when its raw values contradict that claim.
Do not infer source fidelity, strategy quality or repair of the original four-stage workflow merely from arithmetic feasibility.

terminal_reporting.shared_artifacts: All three final audits must identify the same settled run_dir, summary.json and executor revision record hashes; also preserve planner response/record hashes. A missing executor record prevents a success gate.
terminal_reporting.audit_fields: phase='priority1', round, run_dir, audit_completed, all_passed, failed_checks, not_observed_checks, checks(status='pass' only for actual passes), source_files(path,sha256).
terminal_reporting.complete_invalid_executor: Observed failure; do not move it into missing/unknown merely because it fails.
terminal_reporting.executor_not_started_or_incomplete: Retain the attempted/finished planning-role counts and mark final allocation/claim observations unavailable. Never an automatic pass.
terminal_reporting.after_all_three_pass: The separate development gate alone may pass. Priority2 needs its own prospective preparation; full four-stage suitability remains pending.

paper_alignment.supported_pattern: Planning without a final answer is separated from execution of a candidate using task, plan and advice.
paper_alignment.local_adaptations: Same small model used in two roles, financial seven-key JSON, intentional empty weights in the planner, exactly two maximum calls, deterministic numeric feedback, and three offline audits instead of the original full Planner-Executor-Reviewer loop.
paper_alignment.not_supported: The paper does not establish that this model/task will improve, that two calls are optimal, or that an acknowledgment/plan guarantees correction. No reported success rate transfers here.

remaining_before_inference: Review final runner, role guard, tests and input/feedback construction.
Review and hash the exact prepared manifest, all source code and registered budget.
Confirm original failures, source data, rubric and old audit files remain immutable.
